title: 3.9 Graphing Piecewise Functions

icans: I can write and use piecewise functions for real-life situations.

vocab: a function __________ by two or more rules, each on its own part of the domain

blocks.p: $5 for the first hour and $3 for each additional hour. The most you pay in a day is $18.

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Piecewise function: A piecewise function uses _______________ rules, each on its own part of the _______________.
Evaluating: To evaluate, first decide which _______________ the input belongs to.

blocks.stem:
f(x) = 2x + 1 if x < 0;  f(x) = x² if x ≥ 0.
Find f(−3), f(0), and f(4).

notes: Open and closed dots: Open dot: _______________. Closed dot: _______________.

blocks.stem: Graph f(x) = x + 2 if x < 1;  f(x) = −x + 5 if x ≥ 1.

A phone plan costs $40 for up to 5 GB of data and $10 for each GB over 5:
C(g) = 40 if g ≤ 5;  C(g) = 40 + 10(g − 5) if g > 5.
What is the cost for 7 GB?

f(x) = −x if x ≤ 2;  f(x) = 3x − 4 if x > 2.
Find f(2) and f(5).
Use the phone plan from Example 3. What is the cost for 3 GB?
